hypotheses.name: GO-ontology-stratified weighted filtration
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}, compared GO-ontology-stratified weighted-filtration features against the global weighted-filtration model, with stratum-shuffle, confidence-feature shuffle, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.00933; positive rows=9/36; positive mean domain-splits=0/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this GO-overlap stratified additive formulation and keep the simpler global weighted filtration as the active persistent-homology branch.

hypotheses.name: Bridge-curvature graph descriptor blend
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth run across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {0,3,7,11}; added edge bridge-curvature descriptors to H70 and tested degree-preserving edge-swap, descriptor-shuffle, and label-permutation controls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.07710; positive rows=24/24; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run one higher-null-resolution pass with tighter degree-preserving rewiring calibration before deciding promotion versus retirement.

hypotheses.name: Cross-model GO-module topology-rank concordance
hypotheses.method: Seed42 pilot across immune/lung/external_lung and layers {7,11}; computed module-level topology scores for scGPT and Geneformer over GO modules and tested module-score permutation nulls for Spearman/top-module overlap concordance.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=-0.00555; mean null-gap(q95 Spearman)=-0.21467; positive null-gap rows=0/6; positive null-gap domains=0/3
hypotheses.next_action: Keep cross-model alignment retired unless a fundamentally different data view (shared residual-tensor supervision) becomes available.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Repeated cross-model negatives persisted after a major objective change and null-robustness remained 0/3 domains.
